svg.text: Fillet that ends on an equal-radius fillet: before and after the fix
A 10 x 10 x 2.5 plate with a lip and a 1.3 root fillet; the concave end edge is filleted with radius r. Measured through the public API,
Release build of IR at 1c1a90f410, macOS arm64, one library with the fix and the same library without it.
Largest vertex tolerance of the result
Volume removed by a box cut inside the plate (expected 100)
76.46 and an invalid cut at r = 1.3
100.000 and a valid cut at every radius
radius minus 1.3 (symmetric logarithmic scale, 29 radii from -1e-2 to +1e-2)
The end curve of the new fillet
Plane of the ellipse (u along (x + y)/sqrt 2, z up), equal scale, mm.
before: the 3D curve takes the 271 degree arc (parameter 4.712 to 9.442)
Both end at the same two vertices; the pcurves always follow the short arc.
